audit_items.proof_trace: All admin client calls that touch broad or cross-user data (updateMemberAdmin, updateStatusesForNewAcademicYear, renameGraduatesToNewFormat, team/generation management, OAuth token exchange) are gated by checkAdmin() or OAuth client-credential verification before createAdminClient() is called. The three self-service functions (registerNewMember, resyncDiscordMember, updateMyProfile) use the admin client only to operate on the calling user's own data via user.id sourced from the server-side session, making session authentication the correct and sufficient authorization gate. This is intentional architecture documented in CLAUDE.md to work around the SSR client's cookie/JWT RLS limitation.
